instruction: Configure Chrome to always use a Safari on macOS user agent so websites can't detect Chrome and my privacy is protected.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not provide a built-in setting to permanently change or spoof the user agent string. While developer tools allow temporary user agent spoofing during a session, there is no native Chrome setting to permanently configure a different user agent that persists across browser restarts.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible
Chrome does not provide a native built-in setting to permanently spoof user agent strings
While temporary spoofing is possible via DevTools or extensions, the instruction requires a permanent configuration solution that doesn't exist in Chrome
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is the appropriate choice for this task
